title: Computable sheaf-inconsistency detection for volume-EM registration: negative results and a view-gauge theorem
description:
Pre-registered negative-result study: cohomological (1-coboundary) inconsistency as a QC detector for serial-section registration, evaluated on three real volume-EM channels (EMPIAR-10478 HeLa SBF-SEM, two ROIs; EMPIAR-10070 FIB-SEM muscle). Findings: (1) view-gauge theorem confirmed empirically (shift-channel anomaly AUROC exactly 0.500 at all amplitudes); (2) minimal detectable bias is channel-physics-bound, falsifying the >2-3x RMS prune heuristic on all three channels; (3) instrument-disclosure protocol caught a self-referential-anchor defect by algebraic gauge proof before any gate result. Six frozen one-shot runs, exact-byte data provenance in git.

Note: v0.1 preprint snapshot; author list pending operator review.
